explanation: Ash oversleeps and arrives after the three usual starter Pokémon have been taken, so Professor Oak hands him the last one he has, a stubborn Pikachu.

claims.text: In the first episode of the Pokémon anime, Ash receives Pikachu from Professor Oak.
Bulbasaur, Charmander and Squirtle are the three usual starter Pokémon, taken by other trainers before Ash arrives.
Ash oversleeps on the day he is due to collect his first Pokémon.
Pikachu is the last Pokémon Professor Oak has left to give.
